transcription_notes: C-5 REDO 2026-05-20 after prior attempt failed C-6 R1 (printed-edition harmonization). Strict anti-harmonization + preserve-every-rubric + preserve-every-cross discipline applied. CAM transcription of 1 Kings 4 from MS Cambridge Add. 1570 (7760x10328 hi-res JPEGs, ~80MP). Boundaries: START at f127v-L L7 with body word 'ነግሥ' (continuing the clause 'ወእምዝህኮነ ንጉሥ ሰሎምን' begun on L6 of 1Ki3 transcription); immediately after the L7 body phrase 'ነግሥ ላዕለ ኩሉ እስራኤል' comes the red rubric '✣ ክፍል ፰ ✣' (chapter-8 incipit, EXCLUDED from geez per spec §2). END at f127v-R L3 with body word 'ጥበቦ' (last word of v34); immediately after on same L3 comes the red rubric '✣ ክፍል ፱ ✣' (chapter-9 incipit, EXCLUDED). Chapter STAYS WITHIN f127v — does NOT extend onto f128r. IN_FLIGHT cross-check confirmed: section-8 rubric IS at L7 with preceding L6 final word 'ሰሎምን' as the IN_FLIGHT pointer claimed (1Ki3 transcription closes there). R1's claim that the L7 rubric was on L1 was based on misidentification — the L1 rubric is 'ክፍል ፯' marking the end of the prior section that contains the 1Ki3:28 'judgment heard by Israel' content, ALREADY ABSORBED by 1Ki3_witnessCAM_hires.json. So the L7 rubric and forward is the start of the new section (CAM section 8 = biblical 1Ki4). Intra-chapter sub-rubrics observed (each in red, format '✣ ክፍል ፰(?) ✣', numeral hard to disambiguate visually but appears consistent across all four; EXCLUDED from geez body per spec §2 but their positions are documented as boundary markers): (1) f127v-L L20 (sub-rubric immediately preceding v8 'ወዝንቱ ውእቱ አስማቲሆሙ'); (2) f127v-M M8 (immediately preceding v22 'ወኮነ ማእደ ሰሎምን'); (3) f127v-M M19 (immediately preceding v26 'ወቦ ለሰሎምን'); (4) f127v-M M27 (immediately preceding v29 'ወወሀቦ እግዚእብሔር ጥበበ'). Total = 4 intra-chapter sub-rubrics inside the 1Ki4 scope. In-body '✣' clause-crosses preserved: count ~25+ across the scope. Each is a red cross inked in the body to mark clause boundaries — every one observed has been preserved as a '✣' token in tokens[] and in the geez string. Examples: v2 end (L9), v3 mid-cross after 'ሱፋት' (L10) and end (L11), v4 end (L13), v6 end (L16), v9 end (L23), v12 end (L29), v16 end (L38), v17 end (L39), v19 end (M2 with inline ፬ numeral framed by crosses), v20 end (M4), v21 end (M8), v22 end (M11), v23 end (M12), v24 end (M16), v25 end (M19), v28 end (M27), v29 end (M29), v30 end (M32), v32 end (M36), v33 end (R1). Column transitions traced (2 transitions): (1) f127v-L → f127v-M: word 'ምድረ' split — 'ምድ' on L40 end + 'ረ' on M1 start, joined as single token in v19. (2) f127v-M → f127v-R: word 'ዓሣታት' wholly on R1 start, preceded by 'ወበእንተ' on M39 end — NO mid-word split, clean transition. NO f127v → f128r transition (chapter ends on f127v-R L3 before f128r is needed).
